text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening position in first paragraph","quality":"stance clarity","description":"It states a definite position early so the reader knows the writer's argument right away."},{"evidence":"“the problem is that the project would be extremelly expensive”","quality":"reasoned claim","description":"It gives a central reason for its position rather than only listing article facts."},{"evidence":"“I would reader do a boycott”","quality":"argumentative intent","description":"It tries to persuade the reader to take action, which makes the piece more clearly argumentative."},{"evidence":"paragraph structure with opening and supporting paragraph","quality":"organizational coherence","description":"It is divided into parts that function like an introduction and body, making the response easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“this is need to be tested first to make sure that is safer than the manual cars”","quality":"support linked to claim","description":"It connects evidence from the article to a specific safety concern instead of dropping details without explanation."}]}
